blocks.x: Thank you for your purchase. This package gives your business a documented, trade-specific way to use AI tools you already have access to — with clear boundaries around what AI must never be allowed to decide.
This is a document package. It is not software, it does not install anything, and it does not run on its own. Everything here is a PDF you read or a Word file you edit.

blocks.x: The one rule that matters most

AI drafts. Qualified people decide. Nothing in this package authorises AI to set a price, interpret a building code, determine a permit requirement, make a safety decision, or replace licensed technical judgement. Every customer-facing output is reviewed by a person before it is sent.
